credential_store.where: the OpenReceive module's encrypted configuration (php bin/console openreceive:configure)

products: mariadb -uprestashop -pprestashop-local -N prestashop -e "select count(*) from ps_product where active = 1"
orderStatus: mariadb -uprestashop -pprestashop-local -N prestashop -e "select if(s.module_name = 'openreceive' and s.paid = 0, 'awaiting_payment', l.name) from ps_orders o join ps_order_state s on s.id_order_state = o.current_state join ps_order_state_lang l on l.id_order_state = s.id_order_state and l.id_lang = o.id_lang where o.id_order = $1"
